verified: manifest schema version 3 registers four exposed models with bayespfl-general-v1 as the default
Bayes-PFL runtime source files are installer-managed from a pinned upstream revision, verified by exact Git blob IDs, and require no external repository clone
Bayes-PFL artifacts are installer-managed and pinned by filename, byte size, SHA-256, and source metadata
the default Bayes-PFL adapter requires explicit product/category context and preserves the native generic class anomaly
Bayes-PFL owns 518x518 stretch preprocessing, anomaly-map postprocessing, bbox padding, and original-coordinate restoration
the frozen Bayes-PFL application settings are threshold 0.72, Gaussian sigma 8, minimum component area ratio 0.0005, bbox padding ratio 0.25, feature layers 6/12/18/24, and seed 333
the legacy multiclass YOLO general model, steel specialist, and concrete/crack specialist remain exposed and selectable
GET /api/models exposes requiresProductName so the frontend can gate category-guided models before inference
POST /api/inspect and POST /api/stream accept productName and pass it through the shared runtime manager
runtime service caching is scoped by model ID and product/category context for guided models
Dashboard Quick Upload, Inspect, live stream, and Samples share the selected model and guided product context
the frontend disables image/live submission while a required product/category is empty
the inspection viewer derives its preprocessing caption from the selected model profile
the score UI is labelled Quality Score and retains backend qualityScore as authoritative
nine offline CC BY 4.0 showcase images remain source-labelled examples for PCB, steel, and concrete/crack inspection
historical AnomalyCLIP runtime records remain immutable historical evidence and are no longer treated as the current public registry state
the root setup instructions are platform-neutral and the default model installer requires no external model source checkout

known_limitations.detail: Bayes-PFL localizes anomalies but emits the native generic type anomaly rather than a semantic defect subtype. Supported specialists remain preferable when the inspected domain is known.

The fixed 0.72 map threshold, component-area filter, and bbox padding are application adapter settings. Upstream evaluation does not provide a fixed deployment bbox threshold, so these settings are not an upstream accuracy claim.
The upstream Bayes-PFL repository states MIT licensing, but the distributed train_visa.pth checkpoint does not carry a separately stated binary license in the tracked source metadata.

The current Bayes-PFL default integration is ready for the final local validation and runtime probe. Existing committed runtime records cover earlier milestones and specialists; no new Bayes-PFL production result is claimed until that local run is completed.
Python API/detection/storage tests, frontend utility tests, validators, and a production build are present; full browser end-to-end automation is not part of the current repository checks.
